prompt: The array samples contains [12, 18, 9, 21, 15, 24]. Which element object does samples + 3 point to? Give both its zero-based index and its stored value.

feedback.correct: Offset 3 selects index 3, the fourth element. That object currently holds 21.

incorrect.one_based_index: Indexing starts at zero. Offset 3 selects the fourth element, not the third.
incorrect.offset_as_value: The offset selects an element; it is not the value stored in that element.
incorrect.wrong_element_value: You selected the right position. Read the value stored at that index from the model.
incorrect.other: Trace the element offset from index 0, then read that element's stored value.

hints.text: Start counting element positions at index 0.
Move three element positions from the first element, then inspect that slot.
The selected index equals the pointer offset. Use the array model to look up its value.

citations.claim: Adding an integer to an array element pointer advances in elements within the array range.
Array subscripting selects through pointer addition and indirection.
